messages:
Alice H: Heads up: after the cu12 images landed in ap-southeast, we're seeing NCCL allreduce hangs on the baremetal GPU pool. Immediate impact: ~10 nodes reprovision loop, scheduler bouncing pods.
Ben R: Noted. Are these only on nodes built with gcc13 toolchain tag? Which image tag did the reprovisioner push?
Carla M: I grabbed logs from one node — runtime shows a symbol lookup error in libstdc++:
Carla M: `ld.so: undefined symbol: GLIBCXX_3.4.31` — looks like soname mismatch after the container rebuild
Deepak S: Also seeing NCCL WARNs: `NCCL WARN Call to commAllReduce timed out after 30000ms`
CI Bot: deploy/canary-ap-southeast #4821 — healthchecks failing on node gpu-apac-08 (fail fast)
Oncall Pager: Rollout was paused yesterday but a subset still applied — can we roll back the cu12 tag for ap-southeast now?
Alice H: Rolling back for affected pools now. Short-term: taint affected nodes and drain. Long-term: need image rebuild with proper libstdc++ symlink.
Ben R: Taint command I used earlier: `kubectl taint nodes gpu-*/apac cuda-upgrade=broken:NoSchedule` — will prevent new pods landing
Carla M: I'll own the image rebuild. Plan: patch Dockerfile to pin `libstdc++` symlink and rebuild `redwood/cu12-fixed-20260318`, run smoke allreduce tests
Deepak S: Quick verification step after rebuild: `nm -D /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6 | grep GLIBCXX_3.4.31` — if present, then run NCCL microbench
Ben R: Short-term routing: shift heavy NCCL jobs to eu-west pool (avoid cross-region NCCL pairs). Will add nodeSelector override in enqueues.
Alice H: Also note capacity hit — we spun up fallback smaller GPUs in eu-west which increased cross-region egress + 12% cost spike. Finance is on loop.
CI Bot: Canary tests queued. Snippet: ```NCCL WARN Call to commAllReduce timed out after 30000ms
...at /workspace/nccl/allreduce.c:123
``` 
Oncall Pager: Customer-facing note — block new Dedicated provisioning in apac until we confirm stability
Alice H: Agreed. I'll flip dedicated provisioning read-only for apac and post status. Will update here with rebuild progress and smoke test results :wave:
